title: Registry gate allowed scripted popup navigation

before_fix: The registry gate did not classify window.open as a navigation sink
after_fix: Direct and computed window.open calls fail for remote or unresolved destinations
Window aliases and destructured popup references fail closed
Function call/apply and Reflect.apply/Reflect.get popup paths fail closed
reproduction.red_before_fix: The focused popup-navigation regression returned pass before the scanner change and passes after the change.

root_cause: The static source gate rejected external location navigation but did not classify window.open as a programmatic navigation capability.
remediation: Resolve popup references through direct, computed, aliased, destructured, call/apply, and reflected access, and reject remote or unresolved destinations using the same policy as location navigation.

local_validation.registry_popup_regression: 9 hostile access forms rejected; fragment-only navigation accepted
local_validation.cli_black_box_popup_regression: passed; tess gate returns rejected JSON and nonzero process status
local_validation.sites_preview_csp_browser_suite: 20/20 passed across desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844 Chromium
local_validation.browser_popup_probe: No popup, external request, or uncaught exception
local_validation.audit_all: passed all 16 behavioral gates, production build, bundle budgets, provenance, security/secrets, and dependency audit
